reviewer.title: Midterm Exam Reviewer
reviewer.description: Comprehensive sample reviewer covering network architectures, OSI layers, transport protocols, and IP addressing. [Demo Seed Content]

questions.question: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for packet forwarding and logical IP addressing?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer (Layer 3) handles logical addressing (IPv4/IPv6) and routes packets across internetworks.

questions.question: Which of the following protocols operate primarily at Layer 4 (Transport Layer) of the OSI model?
questions.explanation: TCP and UDP are transport-layer protocols providing end-to-end communication services. IP operates at Layer 3, HTTP at Layer 7, and Ethernet at Layer 2.

questions.question: TCP performs a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) before data segments are transmitted.
questions.explanation: True. TCP is connection-oriented and establishes a virtual connection between endpoints using a three-way handshake prior to data exchange.

questions.question: The application-layer protocol that automatically allocates dynamic IP configuration settings to host devices is _____.
questions.explanation: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) assigns dynamic IP addresses, subnet masks, default gateways, and DNS servers to client devices.

questions.question: In which network topology is every node connected to a central device such as a switch?
questions.explanation: Star topology connects all end devices directly to a central networking device (switch or hub). Failure of one cable only disconnects that specific host.

questions.question: A standard Media Access Control (MAC) address is 32 bits in length.
questions.explanation: False. A standard MAC address (EUI-48) is 48 bits (6 octets) in length, whereas an IPv4 address is 32 bits.

questions.question: According to RFC 1918, which of the following address prefixes are reserved for private internet addresses?
questions.explanation: RFC 1918 defines private address blocks: 10.0.0.0/8 (Class A), 172.16.0.0/12 (Class B), and 192.168.0.0/16 (Class C). 127.0.0.0/8 is reserved for loopback, and 8.8.8.8 is a public DNS IP.

questions.question: The hierarchical naming service that translates human-friendly domain names into IP addresses is _____.
questions.explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) translates hostnames like example.com into numeric IP addresses that routers and switches understand.

questions.question: Which protocol provides best-effort, connectionless delivery without flow control or error recovery?
questions.explanation: UDP is connectionless, lightweight, and does not guarantee packet delivery or sequencing, making it ideal for streaming and real-time audio/video.

questions.question: A stateless packet-filtering firewall inspects the payload state and tracks connection handshakes.
questions.explanation: False. Stateless firewalls inspect individual packets in isolation based on headers (IP/ports) without tracking connection state; stateful firewalls track connections.
